title: Communications Manager, AMEA
requiredSkills: Provide timely intelligence and communications counsel to the business - in particular Global’s senior management - on developments in the region as well as issues that could potentially impact on BT brand, both externally and internally
Accountable for delivery of external communications strategy in AMEA
Manage & execute conventional and social media strategy across all key markets in AMEA, including South Africa, the UAE, India, Singapore, China and Australia
Support regional MD and his leadership team with a clear messaging strategy for engagement with external stakeholders, including media, customers, partners and other key opinion formers
Advise on media and content approach, including insights on current issues, themes and opportunities
Design and deliver internal communications strategy for AMEA
Support regional MD and his leadership team with a clear messaging strategy for internal audiences, an appropriate channel strategy and content plan
Design and execute programmes to increase employee motivation, optimise ways of working and improve behaviours, in line with BT’s values and Global’s internal communications strategy
Liaise with the Global Corporate Affairs team for the regional execution of global initiatives – including change programmes, engagement initiatives and crisis management
Drive best practice in the effective use of online internal platforms and channels such as Workplace and intranet
Drive up and maintain presence in BT offices across the region through innovative engagement strategies
Storytelling with data: strong skills in building the case for change, drawing on data and analytical techniques where appropriate, and communicating this to business audiences
Business acumen: Knowledgeable in business strategy and the drivers of organisational performance, including people drivers of performance and financial literacy (e.g. business KPIs, business cases)
Proven skills in communicating change in complex environments
Excellent stakeholder relationship management skills
Persuasive communicator, with great presentation skills
Excellent programme management skills with the capability to juggle a range of large projects and consistently deliver results
Ability to operate within a multinational matrix environment and a culture of sharing and exploiting best practice
Ability to make decisions and respond rapidly under crisis situations and in line with business needs
Experience in a senior PR/media relations role in the global B2B space, with a proven track record in technology PR (IT, cybersecurity, telco, etc)
Degree and post graduate qualification in a related subject (e.g. Business / Marketing / Communications).
Excellent media contacts in the B2B technology space
Great track record in managing internal communications
Crisis communications
Experience in M&A communications
Superb written and spoken communications skills in English, other languages a plus
Agency and budget management experience
jobDescription:
Recruiter: Anuradha Saldi Hiring Manager:Aleksander Straunik Career Grade: D Internal Closing Date: 7 Aug 2026 About the role You will serve as the primary contact for journalists and social media influencers and other external stakeholders, delivering against BT’s ambition to change its perception from a telco to a tech company. This means developing relationships with key media contacts as well as building alliances across industry, professional associations and among BT’s own experts and leaders. You will build awareness and favourable image of the company and ensure BT’s business interests are represented through both, coverage in traditional media and engagement in social media . You will manage internal communications in the region with a goal to improve employee engagement and work with the Purposeful Business team on the delivery of their projects and programmes in the Asia, Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region. What you will be doing (Role Accountabilities)
- Provide timely intelligence and communications counsel to the business
- in particular Global’s senior management
- on developments in the region as well as issues that could potentially impact on BT brand, both externally and internally
- Accountable for delivery of external communications strategy in AMEA
- Manage & execute conventional and social media strategy across all key markets in AMEA, including South Africa, the UAE, India, Singapore, China and Australia
- Support regional MD and his leadership team with a clear messaging strategy for engagement with external stakeholders, including media, customers, partners and other key opinion formers
- Advise on media and content approach, including insights on current issues, themes and opportunities
- Design and deliver internal communications strategy for AMEA
- Support regional MD and his leadership team with a clear messaging strategy for internal audiences, an appropriate channel strategy and content plan
- Design and execute programmes to increase employee motivation, optimise ways of working and improve behaviours, in line with BT’s values and Global’s internal communications strategy
- Liaise with the Global Corporate Affairs team for the regional execution of global initiatives – including change programmes, engagement initiatives and crisis management
- Drive best practice in the effective use of online internal platforms and channels such as Workplace and intranet
- Drive up and maintain presence in BT offices across the region through innovative engagement strategies What you’ll need to succeed (Skills & Experience)
- Storytelling with data: strong skills in building the case for change, drawing on data and analytical techniques where appropriate, and communicating this to business audiences
- Business acumen: Knowledgeable in business strategy and the drivers of organisational performance, including people drivers of performance and financial literacy (e.g. business KPIs, business cases)
- Proven skills in communicating change in complex environments
- Excellent stakeholder relationship management skills
- Persuasive communicator, with great presentation skills
- Excellent programme management skills with the capability to juggle a range of large projects and consistently deliver results
- Ability to operate within a multinational matrix environment and a culture of sharing and exploiting best practice
- Ability to make decisions and respond rapidly under crisis situations and in line with business needs
- Experience in a senior PR/media relations role in the global B2B space, with a proven track record in technology PR (IT, cybersecurity, telco, etc)
- Degree and post graduate qualification in a related subject (e.g. Business / Marketing / Communications).
- Excellent media contacts in the B2B technology space
- Great track record in managing internal communications
- Crisis communications
- Experience in M&A communications
- Superb written and spoken communications skills in English, other languages a plus
- Agency and budget management experience BT Group’s Behaviours Customer First Prioritize customer needs in every decision and action. Challengers Challenge the status quo and bring innovative ideas to life. Committed Own outcomes and deliver with integrity. Clear Communicate openly and simply, ensuring alignment. Connected Collaborate across teams to achieve shared goals. About the role The Communications Specialist delivers tactical strategies to develop the Groups reputation with policymakers, media, third-party and various trade associations to ensure that the Group stays abreast as the social and regulatory environment evolves. What you’ll be doing 1.Plans and produces compelling, audience-specific content to support events and engagement programmes within the business unit, ensuring alignment with the Groups reputation framework and strategic priorities. 2.Manages a broad and complex portfolio of external engagements and communications, including virtual and physical convenings, social media, thought leadership, and customer insights, to enhance stakeholder impact and brand visibility. 3.Identifies and cultivates strategic partnerships with governments, multi-lateral agencies, industry bodies, interest groups, and thought leaders to strengthen the Groups external presence and influence. 4.Oversees the planning, coordination, and participation in high-impact meetings, events, and conferences, ensuring outreach activities are targeted, relevant, and contribute to the Groups reputation and stakeholder engagement goals. 5.Ensures cross-functional alignment with Marketing, Brand, Policy, and Public Affairs teams to maintain consistency of messaging and reinforce the Groups strategic narrative. 6.Champions continuous learning and capability development by sharing insights on emerging trends, technologies, and best practices in communications, fostering innovation and adaptability within the team. Essential Skills / Experience Desirable Skills / Experience Our Package At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens. This means developing relationships with key media contacts as well as building alliances across industry, professional associations and among BT’s own experts and leaders. You will build awareness and favourable image of the company and ensure BT’s business interests are represented through both, coverage in traditional media and engagement in social media . - Provide timely intelligence and communications counsel to the business
- in particular Global’s senior management
- on developments in the region as well as issues that could potentially impact on BT brand, both externally and internally
- Accountable for delivery of external communications strategy in AMEA
- Manage & execute conventional and social media strategy across all key markets in AMEA, including South Africa, the UAE, India, Singapore, China and Australia
- Support regional MD and his leadership team with a clear messaging strategy for engagement with external stakeholders, including media, customers, partners and other key opinion formers
- Advise on media and content approach, including insights on current issues, themes and opportunities
- Design and deliver internal communications strategy for AMEA
- Support regional MD and his leadership team with a clear messaging strategy for internal audiences, an appropriate channel strategy and content plan
- Design and execute programmes to increase employee motivation, optimise ways of working and improve behaviours, in line with BT’s values and Global’s internal communications strategy
- Liaise with the Global Corporate Affairs team for the regional execution of global initiatives – including change programmes, engagement initiatives and crisis management
- Drive best practice in the effective use of online internal platforms and channels such as Workplace and intranet
- Drive up and maintain presence in BT offices across the region through innovative engagement strategies What you’ll need to succeed (Skills & Experience)
- Storytelling with data: strong skills in building the case for change, drawing on data and analytical techniques where appropriate, and communicating this to business audiences
- Business acumen: Knowledgeable in business strategy and the drivers of organisational performance, including people drivers of performance and financial literacy (e.g. business KPIs, business cases)
- Proven skills in communicating change in complex environments
- Excellent stakeholder relationship management skills
- Persuasive communicator, with great presentation skills
- Excellent programme management skills with the capability to juggle a range of large projects and consistently deliver results
- Ability to operate within a multinational matrix environment and a culture of sharing and exploiting best practice
- Ability to make decisions and respond rapidly under crisis situations and in line with business needs
- Experience in a senior PR/media relations role in the global B2B space, with a proven track record in technology PR (IT, cybersecurity, telco, etc)
- Degree and post graduate qualification in a related subject (e.g. Business / Marketing / Communications).
- Excellent media contacts in the B2B technology space
- Great track record in managing internal communications
- Crisis communications
- Experience in M&A communications
- Superb written and spoken communications skills in English, other languages a plus
- Agency and budget management experience BT Group’s Behaviours Customer First Prioritize customer needs in every decision and action. Work with a variety of external customers internally and externally. Engage with multiple teams across various verticals like PM, SRMs, Operations, etc. to ensure that BT security requirements are considered when delivering/developing new services. The Customer Solutions Design Professional assist the creation of end-to-end technical designs and solutions which meet customer needs. What You'll Be Doing Capture customer requirements, develop technical solutions and new security tools to help mitigate security threats and vulnerabilities. Prepare documents like HLDs/LLDs, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), etc. Create solutions that balance business requirements with information and cyber security requirements. Identify security design gaps in existing and proposed architectures and recommend changes or enhancements. Evaluate new technologies and processes that enhance security capabilities. Work with a variety of external customers internally and externally. Engage with multiple teams across various verticals like PM, SRMs, Operations, etc. to ensure that BT security requirements are considered when delivering/developing new services. Essential Skills / Experience Technical Skills
- NGFW: Palo Alto, Fortinet, Juniper, Check Point, Cisco, etc.
- Proxy: Zscaler, Blue Coat
- VPN: SSL, IKE v1 & v2
- Microsegmentation: Illumio Thorough understanding of the latest security principles, techniques, and protocols such as:
- Advanced Persistent Threats (APT)
- Cloud Security (AWS, Azure)
- Sandboxing
- VA/PT
- PKI Experience in Illumio architecture, implementation, labels, and VEN with strong knowledge of application and nano-segmentation best practices. Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work under pressure and communicate effectively. Experience You Would Be Expected to Have
- Core experience in Network and Information Security.
- Hands-on experience in security systems, including NGFW, IPS/IDS, Proxy, AAA, Microsegmentation (Illumio), etc.

title: IT Service Management Professional
jobDescription: Recruiter: Mounika Nagabhiru Hiring Manager: Amit Ghosh Career Grade: E About the role We are seeking an experienced IT Service Management and Data Insights professional skilled in leveraging Service Now’s reporting and analytics capabilities. The role focuses on managing and improving end-to-end IT support reporting for Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, and Service Level Management, ensuring an excellent colleague experience and operational efficiency. This includes governance of IT support services, driving service improvements, monitoring KPI/SLA performance, analysing trends, tying cross-functional teams, and helping digital workplace technologies such as devices, collaboration tools, identity & access, and workplace services. We are seeking an experienced IT Service Management and Data Insights professional skilled in leveraging Service Now’s reporting and analytics capabilities. The role acts as a key link between end users, support teams, and service providers to deliver reliable, customer-centric, and continually improving IT services. What you’ll be doing • Own the end-to-end reporting, analytics, and governance framework for IT Support within the Digital Workplace function, ensuring accurate, consistent, and high-quality service performance insights. • Develop, enhance, and maintain Service Now dashboards and reports covering IT service performance, operational trends, colleague experience, customer sentiment, and other key ITSM use cases. • Use Service Now out-of-the-box reporting, Performance Analytics, and Power BI to deliver workable insights that help data-driven decision-making across IT Support and Service Management. • Translate business requirements and leadership priorities into meaningful KPIs, metrics, dashboards, and executive-level reporting packs aligned to judicious goals. • Proactively identify opportunities to reduce incident volumes through trend analysis, automation, self-service adoption, knowledge management, and permanent corrective actions. • Drive experience-led service improvements by correlating operational metrics, customer feedback, NPS results, and colleague sentiment with service performance data. • Monitor and analyse escalations, ageing tickets, SLA breaches, and repeat contacts to identify systemic issues and drive sustainable service improvements. • Prepare periodic executive summaries and presentations highlighting service health, performance trends, improvement progress, customer sentiment, risks, and key focus areas. • Perform deep-dive analysis to identify recurring issues, service gaps, process inefficiencies, colleague pain points, and key drivers of dissatisfaction across the IT service estate. • Categorise issues by service, issue type, root cause, ownership, and impact area to enable focused remediation, accountability, and measurable service improvement. • Review performance metrics with Service Owners, Process Managers, operational teams, and leadership to drive service improvements, experience enhancements, and risk mitigation actions. • Support Continuous Service Improvement initiatives by providing data-led insights, trend analysis, root cause findings, and recommendations for operational improvement. • Ensure strong data quality, governance, consistency, and accuracy across all reporting, visualisation, and metric management activities. • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to improve reporting maturity, strengthen ITSM governance, and ensure service performance insights are clear, reliable, and business-relevant. • Provide methodical support for governance forums, service reviews, RCA discussions, escalation reviews, and improvement planning across the Digital Workplace colleague support model. Essential Skills / Experience • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline. • 10+ years of experience in IT Service Management within a large-scale enterprise environment, with strong exposure to Digital Workplace and End-to-End IT Support operations. • Demonstrate expertise in implementing, governing, and continuously improving IT service management • Strong understanding of ITIL best practices, particularly Incident, Request, Problem, Change, Knowledge, and Service Level Management. • Hands-on experience with Service Now & similar ITSM platforms for service delivery, reporting, process management, and governance. • Strong Handson experience in Data Visualization platform like Power Bi, Qlik etc • Ability to build the Data model independently • Strong governance mindset with experience in service reviews, KPI/SLA management, risk mitigation, and service improvement planning. • Excellent methodical and problem-solving capabilities, with a demonstrate track record of identifying root causes, driving corrective actions, and delivering continual service improvements. • Strong reporting and data analysis skills, with the ability to derive workable insights from service performance metrics, trends, and customer feedback. • experience in stakeholder, vendor, and escalation management • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. • Illustrated collaboration, learning agility, growth mindset, and a passion for driving operational excellence. • Experience working across Digital Workplace functions, including endpoint services, collaboration platforms, identity & access management, workplace support services, and colleague experience initiatives. • Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL v4 Managing Professional, Service Now are highly desirable. Our Package BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers. BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive. Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best. We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies. title: Network Design Specialist
jobDescription:
Job Req ID: 59617 Posting Date: 11-June-26 Function: Network Engineering Location: Bengaluru Salary: Competitive About the role The purpose of this role is to lead on design and test activities within BT International. The purpose of the Network Engineering Specialist role is to deliver network designs for BT International network platforms and/or customer solutions. Specifically, this role is answerable for: • Driving efficiency and scalability through the re-use of IP Internet/VPN network designs and ongoing in-life operation of designs across the overall BT International network platforms and/or customer solution. • Typically leading a matrix (virtual) team of technical experts/contractors to deliver network design solutions and provide technical thought leadership to a larger matrix team. The sphere of influence for the matrix team will be from a technical perspective. • Acting as a technical ambassador for the company and providing good technical consulting to customers at a platform and/or overall solution level. • Deciding on design scope and design of the overall BT International network platforms and/or customer solution. What you’ll be doing The purpose of the Network Engineering Specialist engineer role is to lead the design of IP Internet/VPN technologies. Specifically, this role is accountable for: • Design accountability for new features into T International’s network platforms. • Provide thought leadership to senior internal stakeholders and customers regarding aspects of Global Reach platforms and/or customer solutions. • Point of contact for technical expertise to senior stakeholders, internal and external. • Mentor and share knowledge with others and be an advanced user of design tools. • Create and develop architecture patterns and design techniques for BT and/or customers. • Lead on resolving customer impacting issues regarding the overall network platform and/or customer solution. • Solve problems that tend to arise from the interaction of multiple components and usually are complex and unknown related to the overall IP Internet/VPN platform and/or customer solution and involve vendor interworking issues. • Raise and resolve implementation issues with suppliers and other designers. • Resolve in-life issues to overall network platform and/or customer solution, as appropriate. • Lead a matrix team as appropriate within BT International. • Estimate the time and type of resource needed to help deliverables with increasing cost impact and time duration. • Drive transformation specifically in terms of automation, Essential Skills / Experience • Specialist knowledge of IP/VPN technologies and vendors (Cisco/Juniper) • Specialist knowledge of relevant emerging network/software technologies. • Experience of leading matrix teams to deliver network designs and testing. • Software development skills specifically in solving network issues / activities. • Experience in resolution of customer impacting network issues. • Prior experience of designing network solutions in a service provider setting. • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and tools such as Gitlab is essential. • Working knowledge of automation test frameworks such as Behavior Driven Development (BDD) and/or Robot Framework is desirable. • Hand-on demonstratable experience with core routing technologies (IS-IS, BGP, BGP-LS, SR-TE, SR IGP, PCEP, MPLS-VPNs) • Understanding and hand-on experience with Quality of Service (Qo S). • Expertise in developing frameworks for and automating test cases for systems in production • Experience with data modelling with Yang (with a vendor neutral landscape in mind) • Solid experience with g RPC, JSON. Typical Certifications/Accreditations Attained or working towards include: Member of a professional body e.g. Institution of Engineering and Technology Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) and/or Cisco Dev Net Professional or equivalent experience. Certified Tester Advanced Level Test Analyst (CTAL-TA) or equivalent PCET
- Certified Entry Level Tester with Python PCEP
- Certified Entry-Level Python Programmer Robot Framework Certified Professional (RFCP) or equivalent Desirable Skills / Experience • Leader of matrix technology team. • Delivery of IP network design • Strong collaboration skills. • Ability to lead / coach teams to change and develop an innovative, challenging, and supportive team culture. Our Package At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens. Job Req ID: 59617 Posting Date: 11-June-26 Function: Network Engineering Location: Bengaluru Salary: Competitive About the role The purpose of this role is to lead on design and test activities within BT International. The purpose of the Network Engineering Specialist role is to deliver network designs for BT International network platforms and/or customer solutions. Specifically, this role is answerable for: • Driving efficiency and scalability through the re-use of IP Internet/VPN network designs and ongoing in-life operation of designs across the overall BT International network platforms and/or customer solution. • Typically leading a matrix (virtual) team of technical experts/contractors to deliver network design solutions and provide technical thought leadership to a larger matrix team. The sphere of influence for the matrix team will be from a technical perspective. • Acting as a technical ambassador for the company and providing good technical consulting to customers at a platform and/or overall solution level. • Deciding on design scope and design of the overall BT International network platforms and/or customer solution. What you’ll be doing The purpose of the Network Engineering Specialist engineer role is to lead the design of IP Internet/VPN technologies. Specifically, this role is accountable for: • Design accountability for new features into T International’s network platforms. • Provide thought leadership to senior internal stakeholders and customers regarding aspects of Global Reach platforms and/or customer solutions. • Point of contact for technical expertise to senior stakeholders, internal and external. • Mentor and share knowledge with others and be an advanced user of design tools. • Create and develop architecture patterns and design techniques for BT and/or customers. • Lead on resolving customer impacting issues regarding the overall network platform and/or customer solution. • Solve problems that tend to arise from the interaction of multiple components and usually are complex and unknown related to the overall IP Internet/VPN platform and/or customer solution and involve vendor interworking issues. • Raise and resolve implementation issues with suppliers and other designers. • Resolve in-life issues to overall network platform and/or customer solution, as appropriate. • Lead a matrix team as appropriate within BT International. • Estimate the time and type of resource needed to help deliverables with increasing cost impact and time duration. • Drive transformation specifically in terms of automation, Essential Skills / Experience • Specialist knowledge of IP/VPN technologies and vendors (Cisco/Juniper) • Specialist knowledge of relevant emerging network/software technologies. • Experience of leading matrix teams to deliver network designs and testing. • Software development skills specifically in solving network issues / activities. • Experience in resolution of customer impacting network issues. • Prior experience of designing network solutions in a service provider setting. • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and tools such as Gitlab is essential. • Working knowledge of automation test frameworks such as Behavior Driven Development (BDD) and/or Robot Framework is desirable. • Hand-on demonstratable experience with core routing technologies (IS-IS, BGP, BGP-LS, SR-TE, SR IGP, PCEP, MPLS-VPNs) • Understanding and hand-on experience with Quality of Service (Qo S). • Expertise in developing frameworks for and automating test cases for systems in production • Experience with data modelling with Yang (with a vendor neutral landscape in mind) • Solid experience with g RPC, JSON. Typical Certifications/Accreditations Attained or working towards include: Member of a professional body e.g. Institution of Engineering and Technology Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) and/or Cisco Dev Net Professional or equivalent experience. Certified Tester Advanced Level Test Analyst (CTAL-TA) or equivalent PCET
- Certified Entry Level Tester with Python PCEP
- Certified Entry-Level Python Programmer Robot Framework Certified Professional (RFCP) or equivalent Desirable Skills / Experience • Leader of matrix technology team. • Delivery of IP network design • Strong collaboration skills. • Ability to lead / coach teams to change and develop an innovative, challenging, and supportive team culture. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens. jobDescription:
Job Req ID: Posting Date: Function: Location: Salary: About the role This role strengthens end to end operational governance across strategic partners and internal user communities by driving clarity, discipline, and continuous improvement. The role ensures:
- Partner performance is measured, visible, and improved through robust KPI frameworks, insights, and structured improvement actions.
- User feedback is systematically captured, triaged, prioritised, converted into deliverables, and tracked to closure to improve tools and colleague experience. It plays a pivotal role in quarterly governance (QBRs), performance reporting, and service improvement, acting as a bridge between internal users, product & engineering teams, and partner organisations. What you’ll be doing
1. Partner Performance & KPI Governance
- Own and operate the partner performance framework, including KPIs, scorecards, thresholds, and reporting cadence.
- Ensure performance data is accurate, visible, and actionable, with clear ownership of outcomes.
- Lead performance reviews with partners, identifying trends, systemic issues, and opportunities for improvement.
- Drive and track partner improvement plans, ensuring issues translate into tangible corrective actions.
- Support constructive challenge and escalation where performance or delivery is at risk.
2. Financial Tracking & Cost Governance
- Provide operational ownership of partner related financial tracking, working closely with Finance and Commercial teams.
- Ensure clear visibility of:
- Partner run rate and committed spend
- Forecast vs actuals
- Financial risks linked to delivery or performance issues
- Track financial actions and assumptions arising from governance forums and QBRs.
- Support identification of cost pressures, inefficiencies, and avoidance opportunities linked to tooling, ways of working, or partner performance. Ensure financial implications are clearly reflected in governance discussions and decision making.
3. Quarterly & Operational Governance (QBRs)
- Plan, structure, and run Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and supporting governance forums.
- Ensure governance discussions focus on outcomes, decisions, risks, and actions, not just reporting.
- Maintain clear logs of actions, owners, and timelines, and ensure effective follow through.
- Provide concise, executive ready governance packs and performance insights.
4. User Feedback & Demand Management
- Establish and operate a clear, disciplined feedback and demand intake process for internal tool users. Ensure feedback is, Logged and categorised, Triaged and prioritised, Converted into clear delivery items or improvement actions
- Track all feedback and improvement items end to end, from intake to closure.
- Provide transparency to users on status, decisions, and delivery progress, improving trust and engagement.
5. Cross Functional Orchestration
- Act as a single coordination point between, Internal operational users, Product owners and engineering teams, Strategic partners and suppliers
- Translate operational needs and user feedback into clear, structured inputs for product and engineering backlogs.
- Support prioritisation discussions to ensure alignment between operational urgency, value, and delivery capacity.
- Monitor progress and ensure delivered outcomes meet operational expectations.
6. Insights, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
- Produce clear, concise performance and governance reporting for senior stakeholders.
- Identify recurring issues, delivery bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities across partners and tools.
- Embed a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and data led decision making. Bring in process automation, industry standard adoption and tool adoption to streamline and smoothen the process challenges.
- Help mature governance from reactive issue management to proactive performance improvement. Essential Skills / Experience
- Experience in operational governance, service management, or delivery oversight roles.
- Strong experience managing partner or supplier performance, including KPI based governance.
- Proven experience running QBRs or equivalent senior governance forums.
- Solid understanding of financial tracking concepts (run rate, forecast, actuals, cost drivers) and usage of tools such as SAP, Ariba, Share Point, etc.
- Ability to structure ambiguity into clear actions, decisions, and deliverables.
- Strong stakeholder management skills across operations, product, engineering, finance, and suppliers.
- Process automation and industry standard tools adoption.
- High attention to detail with strong action and financial tracking discipline. Desirable Skills / Experience
- Experience working with internal OSS tools, platforms, or OSS/BSS environments.
- Exposure to cost recovery, supplier commercials, or financial governance models.
- Experience operating in multi supplier or strategic partner ecosystems. But it’s not just the technology that matters, it’s what it can do to help them build stronger, smarter, more secure businesses. What you’ll be doing • Supports in the execution of technical decisions, technology choices and architecture for a wide range of high-performance products, capabilities, and platforms, effectively balancing short-term impact with long-term transformation. • Supports the design and development of software solutions in accordance with the wider architecture and security standards. • Supports with the designs of technical specifications and development of software solutions of smaller and /or less complex initiatives in partnership with team, contributing towards the quality of delivery. • Establish the product vision and produce relevant objectives and key results for the development squads. • Improving service reliability and stability across critical applications and platforms. • Strengthening operational resilience through proactive monitoring and incident management. • Enhancing security posture through Sec Ops practices, vulnerability management, and governance. • Driving automation and operational efficiency across ITSM and application support processes. • Supporting digital transformation and application modernisation initiatives. • Providing clear operational visibility through dashboards, monitoring, and reporting. • Supports the delivery of an ambitious and compelling technical roadmap to meet the needs of the business, engineering team, and partner teams. • May support product and operational excellence initiatives, assisting with implementing metrics and processes for regular assessment and improvement. • Actively seek feedback from our customers to help unlock value and remove issues in our product suite. • Actively engage with the security and compliance teams to ensure what we deliver is fit for purpose. • Collaborating with other product leaders to contribute to company-wide best practices and standards. • Interact with cross-functional teams to understand the business requirements and convert them into effective solutions. • Ensure the continued implementation of a test first approach, and implement the clean architecture principles. • Enables prioritisation of key features with stakeholders using a range of techniques to establish value and business benefit Essential Skills / Experience Reliability & Operations • Ensure 24×7 reliability, availability, and performance of critical digital services and applications. • Monitor system health and proactively detect and prevent service disruptions. • Build and operate secure, resilient, and fault-tolerant systems. • Improve system scalability, stability, and overall service health. IT Service Management (ITSM) • Work extensively with Service Now modules, including: o Incident Management o Change Management o Service Request Management • Improve operational processes and workflows through automation and standardisation. • Support service governance and continuous service improvement initiatives. Application Development & Support • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve application reliability and supportability. • Develop and maintain automation scripts and operational tooling using Python, Go Lang, .NET, Maria DB, React JS and Postgres. • Support application modernisation initiatives and improve maintainability of services. • Build integrations and APIs to streamline operational workflows. Dev Ops & Automation • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment reliability and release efficiency. • Implement Infrastructure as Code (Ia C) and configuration management practices. • Reduce manual operational effort through automation and orchestration. • Support Git Ops and Dev Ops best practices across engineering teams. Observability & Monitoring • Implement monitoring and observability solutions using tools such as Dynatrace, Open Search, and Grafana. • Build dashboards and alerts for proactive issue detection and operational visibility. • Improve logging, metrics, and tracing capabilities across applications and services. Security Operations (Sec Ops) • Implement and enforce security governance aligned with enterprise security standards and policies. • Lead end-to-end vulnerability management, including: o Vulnerability identification o Prioritisation o Remediation tracking o Governance reporting • Implement secure configurations, access controls, and RBAC practices. • Support audit and compliance requirements. Disaster Recovery & Resilience • Ensure Disaster Recovery (DR) readiness and resilience planning. • Participate in DR exercises and resilience testing. • Implement failover and recovery mechanisms for critical services. Infrastructure & Platforms • Basic understanding of: o Linux and Windows administration o Databases (SQL) o Networking concepts o Cloud platforms and architectures Desirable Skills / Experience • Experience with multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). • Exposure to containerisation technologies and container security. • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform. • Knowledge of Dev Sec Ops practices. • Experience implementing self-healing and operational automation solutions. • Understanding of application modernisation and cloud-native architectures. jobDescription:
The Site Reliability Engineering Professional is responsible for supporting BT to be in the best position to deliver the service performance, reliability and availability that internal and external customers expect. What you’ll be doing
1. Supports the implementation of new software development life cycle automation tools, frameworks, and code pipelines (continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines), helps to elevate the organisation using best practices with a focus on the re-use of application code, demonstrates consistent software delivery practices and produces continuous integration/continuous delivery platform solutions using Amazon Web Services Cloud, infrastructure as code (Ia C), Git Ops, and container technologies
2. Supports teammates and engineering teams to identify and implement requirements for building a high-end developer experience enabling quick, autonomous, and secure delivery of production changes
3. Supports the maintenance of monitoring tooling used to optimise systems for uptime, performance, and reliability
4. Executes tests to investigate how the infrastructure handles failure and scaling
5. Supports the execution of approaches that scale systems sustainably through automation mechanisms and evolves systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity
6. Supports the delivery of infrastructure as code software to improve the availability, scalability, latency, and efficiency of services
7. Executes quality control/quality assurance on new clusters and software deployments
8. Supports the operation and management of distributed storage architecture
9. Monitors queue and support processing to support in the identification of early warning of support issues
10. Supports in the implementation of ways to improve working processes within the area of site reliability engineering responsibility, such as contributing to the design of continuous integration/continuous delivery systems Essential Skills / Experience Desirable Skills / Experience Our Package The Site Reliability Engineering Professional is responsible for supporting BT to be in the best position to deliver the service performance, reliability and availability that internal and external customers expect. title: Technical Delivery Specialist
jobDescription:
The Site Reliability Engineering Manager manages a team within the site reliability engineering organisation ensuring BT delivers the service performance, reliability and availability that internal and external customers expect, through contributing in cross-functional engineering discussions to achieve scalable, measurable, fault-tolerant, and cost-effective cloud services. What you’ll be doing
1. Coordinates teams through the implementation of new software development life cycle automation tools, frameworks, and code pipelines (continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines), ensures teams follow best practices with a focus on the re-use of application code, and demonstrates consistent software delivery practices and produces continuous integration/continuous delivery platform solutions using cloud, infrastructure as code and container technologies
2. Collaborates with engineering leadership in supporting the development of the architectures and practices that should be adopted in order to deliver on engineering and operational goals
3. Provides technical support to product teams to optimise availability, latency, performance, efficiency, change management, monitoring, emergency response, and capacity planning
4. Solves problems relating to mission-critical services and builds automation to prevent problem recurrence with the goal of automated response to all non-exceptional service conditions
5. Executes new builds of infrastructure tooling that improves reliability across the entire product surface area, dealing with massive distributed scale
6. Coordinates the work with development teams during design phase, to build and perform infrastructure upgrades to support applications availability and reliability
7. Manages the current-state solution portfolio to identify deficiencies through aging of the technologies used by the application, or misalignment with business requirements
8. Leads a team in the implementation of approaches that scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation and evolves systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity
9. Oversees the delivery of infrastructure as code software to improve the availability, scalability, latency, and efficiency of services
10. Oversees the implementation of robust monitoring and alerting systems
11. Manages the queue and support processing to ensure early warning of support issues
12. Owns and leads retrospective and preventive actions after each high severity production incident
13. Champions, continuously develops and shares with team knowledge on emerging trends and changes in site reliability engineering best practices and industry standards
14. Coaches talent, and manages others, to develop capabilities and ensure performance through upskilling, development and recruitment
15. The Site Reliability Engineering Manager manages a team within the site reliability engineering organisation ensuring BT delivers the service performance, reliability and availability that internal and external customers expect, through contributing in cross-functional engineering discussions to achieve scalable, measurable, fault-tolerant, and cost-effective cloud services. What you’ll be doing
1. Coordinates teams through the implementation of new software development life cycle automation tools, frameworks, and code pipelines (continuous integration/continuous delivery pipelines), ensures teams follow best practices with a focus on the re-use of application code, and demonstrates consistent software delivery practices and produces continuous integration/continuous delivery platform solutions using cloud, infrastructure as code and container technologies
2. Collaborates with engineering leadership in supporting the development of the architectures and practices that should be adopted in order to deliver on engineering and operational goals
3. Provides technical support to product teams to optimise availability, latency, performance, efficiency, change management, monitoring, emergency response, and capacity planning
4. Solves problems relating to mission-critical services and builds automation to prevent problem recurrence with the goal of automated response to all non-exceptional service conditions
5. Executes new builds of infrastructure tooling that improves reliability across the entire product surface area, dealing with massive distributed scale
6. Coordinates the work with development teams during design phase, to build and perform infrastructure upgrades to support applications availability and reliability
7. Manages the current-state solution portfolio to identify deficiencies through aging of the technologies used by the application, or misalignment with business requirements
8. Leads a team in the implementation of approaches that scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation and evolves systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity
9. Oversees the delivery of infrastructure as code software to improve the availability, scalability, latency, and efficiency of services
10. Oversees the implementation of robust monitoring and alerting systems
11. Manages the queue and support processing to ensure early warning of support issues
12. Owns and leads retrospective and preventive actions after each high severity production incident
13. Champions, continuously develops and shares with team knowledge on emerging trends and changes in site reliability engineering best practices and industry standards
14. Coaches talent, and manages others, to develop capabilities and ensure performance through upskilling, development and recruitment
15. title: Executive Assistant
requiredSkills: Accountable for managing and prioritising the diary, ensuring most effective use of time and creating adequate breaks, prep and task time.
Able to filter and prioritise requests, solve conflicts and delegate where appropriate; creating a reference library of prioritisation and meetings that can be delegated.
Integrate and synchronise personal commitments and actively seek these out for the full year.
Instigate regular office meetings to plan and discharge actions and tasks.

Be creative in using the calendar and creating reminders for completing tasks; team leave and attendance; apologies sent for meeting; storing meeting papers; adding travel time and importantly keeping slots free so that another PA can see Outlook availability.
Co-ordinate and manage every aspect of travel itinerary (including venue bookings) anticipating all needs, ensuring cost effectiveness and compliance
Works with content owners on coordinating and preparing meeting papers (at least 48hrs in advance) and builds in prep time where required.
Sets the process for reading papers (e.g. store in calendar, print, diary time).
Strong at using Microsoft Word and PowerPoint as necessary to create and edit agendas, slides, briefing papers.
Prompts when overrunning / late for next meeting
Develops processes to ensure urgent or timebound emails are dealt with and actions completed.
Responds to routine emails and delegates as appropriate. Regularly scans and cleans up Junk folders.
Develops knowledge and skills of new technologies and how they are used in BT.
Stays up to date on digital technology and applications making time for training and seeking out best practice.
Proficient in O365 and IT applications and setting up Teams channels for chats, meetings, and collaboration.
Advanced knowledge and expert on internal systems and processes, i.e., room bookings, catering, finance, and travel
Ensure compliance to BT processes and policy demonstrating financial awareness for business requests (POs, Orderdesk, Travel, A/L)
Co-ordinates and supports Leadership Team visits in Bangalore
Produces or edits Microsoft Word or PowerPoint documents
Solves simple IT problems on behalf of the team.
Responsible for onboarding of any new members of the team, creating a reusable guide to ensure the process is efficient.
Attends meetings to take notes/actions, endeavouring to chase and close these.
Develops great working relationships with stakeholders agreeing ways of working and regularly connecting to align on priorities and build understanding.
Take responsibility for continuous learning and agreeing personal development
Develops and maintains internal and external relationships to improve impact across the business
Creates a PA support network for providing holiday cover and seeks out opportunities to cover EA role.
Offers advice when requested for a single decision, making recommendations for or against.
Uses knowledge of best practice to collaborate with peers across the business in different ways.
Co-ordinates all people calls/webcasts/events working with content owners on preparing agenda and material.
Co-ordinates engagement & visibility plans including virtual.

- Co-ordinate and manage every aspect of travel itinerary (including venue bookings) anticipating all needs, ensuring cost effectiveness and compliance Meeting Preparation
- Works with content owners on coordinating and preparing meeting papers (at least 48hrs in advance) and builds in prep time where required.
- Sets the process for reading papers (e.g. store in calendar, print, diary time).
- Strong at using Microsoft Word and Power Point as necessary to create and edit agendas, slides, briefing papers.
- Prompts when overrunning / late for next meeting Email Management
- Develops processes to ensure urgent or timebound emails are dealt with and actions completed.
- Responds to routine emails and delegates as appropriate. Regularly scans and cleans up Junk folders. Technology
- Develops knowledge and skills of new technologies and how they are used in BT.
- Stays up to date on digital technology and applications making time for training and seeking out best practice.
- Proficient in O365 and IT applications and setting up Teams channels for chats, meetings, and collaboration.
- Advanced knowledge and expert on internal systems and processes, i.e., room bookings, catering, finance, and travel Primary Point of Contact / Call Management for the office and virtual office. Screens and filters calls and visitors acting as a gatekeeper. Safety, Security, Ethics & Compliance
- Ensure compliance to BT processes and policy demonstrating financial awareness for business requests (POs, Orderdesk, Travel, A/L) Special Projects & Ad hoc
- Co-ordinates and supports Leadership Team visits in Bangalore
- Produces or edits Microsoft Word or Power Point documents
- Solves simple IT problems on behalf of the team.
- Responsible for onboarding of any new members of the team, creating a reusable guide to ensure the process is efficient.
- Attends meetings to take notes/actions, endeavouring to chase and close these. Essential Skills / Experience Stakeholder Management & Collaboration
- Develops great working relationships with stakeholders agreeing ways of working and regularly connecting to align on priorities and build understanding.
- Take responsibility for continuous learning and agreeing personal development
- Develops and maintains internal and external relationships to improve impact across the business

- Co-ordinates all people calls/webcasts/events working with content owners on preparing agenda and material.
- Co-ordinates engagement & visibility plans including virtual. At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

title: Technical Delivery Specialist
requiredSkills: Delivery Execution: Proven experience delivering telecom products/services, translating vision into achievable delivery plans and managing the full technical lifecycle to drive business outcomes.
Risk & Dependency Management: Identifies and manages risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers across teams and stakeholders.
Outcome & Performance Focus: Drives squads toward agreed outcomes, maintaining pace, accountability, and performance.

Organisational Transformation: Leads change initiatives, manages stakeholders, and ensures alignment from concept through implementation.

Financial & Planning Awareness: Supports budget management, forecasting, and expenditure tracking.
Inclusive Leadership: Builds motivated, collaborative teams and addresses people and performance issues proactively.
jobDescription:
Recruiter: Seema Shivakumar Hiring Manager: Karan Mohan Grover Career Grade: D About the role • Our Technical Delivery Specialists help make our squads more effective, work at their best and are accountable to drive the day-to-day management of squad delivery, ensuring adherence to roadmaps, time and budget constraints. • This role will be looking after engineering squads within the Business Billing Transformation Team, which is responsible for improving the Customer & Digital Experience for the BT Business Billing & Pay Journeys across customers and internal BT Billing users. • Delivery Specialists lead the cadence of events needed to keep our squads organised, proactively identify and resolve risks and issues relating to delivery and any impact on related squads or teams. They work full time alongside their squads and teams, coordinating delivery activity and fostering strong collaboration across disciplines. What you’ll be doing • Leads the day-to-day delivery of the squad(s) ensuring alignment with the defined roadmap, timeline, and budget constraints using the Ready, Set, Go delivery framework. • Technical skills are a mandatory requirement for this role. The successful candidate must possess sufficient technical knowledge and credibility to engage effectively with engineering teams, understand technical solutions and dependencies, challenge assumptions when necessary, and drive informed discussions across upstream and downstream teams to ensure successful end-to-end delivery. • Facilitates key delivery planning, review, and alignment activities including agile ceremonies where appropriate, driving team collaboration and efficiency. Drives quarterly planning to ensure each timebox has clearly expressed outcomes and a well-defined backlog. • Partners with internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues and provide regular progress updates, ensuring squad(s) objectives are achieved. Ensure continuous alignment and re-alignment with stakeholders. • Establishes a performance-driven culture within the squad(s), ensuring high standards and continuous delivery are aligned with business goals. Actively seeks to improve a squad(s)’ working practices where needed. • Orchestrates efforts across disciplines towards clear outcomes. Identifies risks and blockers affecting delivery and coordinates mitigation efforts, ensuring smooth squad(s) operations and minimal disruption across teams. • Drives collaboration across squad(s) to ensure dependencies are managed effectively and delivery is optimised. Proactively identifies and brings the right people together at the right time. Knows when and how to involve stakeholders in communications, ceremonies and decision-making. • Ensures the use of the most suitable delivery methodology to achieve the best outcome. Supports squads in strengthening effective working practices and applies a structured, objective approach to problem solving. Responsible for ensuring the portfolio of work within your Squads are on track and teams are working to clearly defined and well communicated outcomes. • Communicates and visualises progress towards agreed goals and maintains delivery momentum. Works closely with other Technical Delivery Specialists and to enhance the application of delivery practices and foster cross-squad collaboration. • Ensures the squad(s) adheres to the delivery roadmap, managing scope, budgets, and timelines to meet business expectations. Ensure work is visible and there is an iterative plan to work towards that is actively communicated and understood by squads & stakeholders. • Fosters a continuous improvement mindset within the squad(s), promoting learning, innovation, and effective problem-solving including measuring success, inspecting and adapting. • Help develop the technical delivery capability within the organisation by role modelling and embedding technical practices within teams Essential Skills / Experience
- Delivery Execution: Proven experience delivering telecom products/services, translating vision into achievable delivery plans and managing the full technical lifecycle to drive business outcomes.
- Risk & Dependency Management: Identifies and manages risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers across teams and stakeholders.
- Outcome & Performance Focus: Drives squads toward agreed outcomes, maintaining pace, accountability, and performance.
- Cross-Functional Working: Collaborates across functions to define goals, align plans, and foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture.
- Organisational Transformation: Leads change initiatives, manages stakeholders, and ensures alignment from concept through implementation.
- Decision Making & Stakeholder Management: Facilitates communication, resolves problems, and influences positive outcomes across teams.
- Software Development Lifecycle: Strong understanding of delivery practices and enterprise technology environments.
- Delivery Planning: Leads strategic and iterative planning, roadmap development, capacity management, and stakeholder communications.
- Continuous Improvement: Promotes a data-driven culture of learning, measurement, adaptation, and process improvement.
- Performance Management: Optimizes delivery processes, improving efficiency, quality, and value delivery.
- Technical & Operational Awareness: Balances cost, quality, reliability, and timelines in enterprise technology delivery.
- Test, Trial & Launch Management: Manages testing, release readiness, defect governance, operational readiness, and delivery roadmaps.
- Collaboration Across Disciplines: Brings together the right expertise to maintain delivery momentum and resolve challenges.
- Communication Skills: Communicates effectively with technical and business stakeholders and facilitates complex discussions.
- Financial & Planning Awareness: Supports budget management, forecasting, and expenditure tracking.
- Inclusive Leadership: Builds motivated, collaborative teams and addresses people and performance issues proactively. BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers. BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive. Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best. We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies. title: IT Systems Architect Principal
jobDescription:
At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens. Why this job matters The IT Systems Architect Principal is central to BT International's ability to deliver products at velocity while maintaining operational excellence. This role owns the platform transformation and vendor rationalization strategy that directly impacts product team autonomy, cost efficiency and speed to market. This architect ensures every architectural decision drives product velocity and long-term value. This position leads vendor rationalization, establishes composable platform patterns and collaborates with senior stakeholders. By aligning platform architecture with business imperatives and group strategy, the role ensures BT International remains competitive, agile and customer-focused in a rapidly evolving global landscape. What you’ll be doing
1. Define and lead the architectural strategy for IT systems and BSS modernization across BT International, establishing the target state architecture that guides system rationalization, vendor consolidation and platform transformation initiatives
2. Own the application portfolio rationalization roadmap, making strategic keep/modernize/retire decisions based on technical fitness, business value and architectural alignment while managing stakeholder expectations
3. Establish API-first integration architecture that decouples BSS systems from each other and from product applications, creating clear service boundaries that enable independent team delivery and reduce system dependencies
4. Lead vendor rationalization strategy across Saa S platforms, on-premise systems and cloud-based solutions, reducing vendor dependencies through strategic build vs buy decisions and phasing out unnecessary third-party systems in favor of composable in-house capabilities
5. Champion modern architecture patterns including microservices, event-driven integration and API gateways that enable incremental transformation without big-bang rewrites
6. Collaborate with Data & AI architects to ensure IT systems generate high-quality data with proper lineage and governance, enabling analytics and AI capabilities across the platform Skills and Experience The skills you’ll need to succeed Strategic Architecture Leadership – Proven ability to define and communicate architectural vision for complex enterprise landscapes, with track record driving large-scale modernization programs in regulated industries BSS Domain Expertise – Deep understanding of telco BSS systems including billing, order management, product catalog, CPQ and customer lifecycle management, with knowledge of how these capabilities support business operations Platform Integration Architecture – Extensive experience designing API-first integration architectures, event-driven patterns and service abstraction layers that enable loose coupling in complex system landscapes, coding capability in at least one language, enabling credibility with engineering teams and hands-on spike work when needed Vendor & Stakeholder Management – Strong ability to work with enterprise software vendors as strategic partners, negotiate technical implementations and manage complex stakeholder relationships across business and technology teams,ability to lead through influence rather than authority Platform Engineering Mindset – Understanding of platform-as-a-product principles, developer experience design and how to build self-service capabilities that enable team autonomy at scale Experience you’d be expected to have Mandatory Strong engineering background with hands-on experience in software development or systems engineering, demonstrating technical credibility through active contribution to architecture implementations, POCs and technical spikes Extensive experience leading IT systems and BSS architecture in telecommunications or complex B2B environments, with demonstrated success modernizing legacy landscapes across multiple system domains Experience building and leading architecture teams, with track record developing technical leadership capability and establishing architectural practices that scale across product engineering organizations Proven track record defining and executing architectural strategies that enabled large-scale system rationalization, vendor consolidation and platform transformation while maintaining business continuity Significant experience establishing API-first integration architectures in complex enterprise environments, including work with API management platforms, event streaming and microservices patterns Nice to have Strong background working with major enterprise platforms (Salesforce, Service Now, Microsoft) and telco-specific BSS vendors, including negotiating technical approaches and influencing vendor roadmaps Demonstrated success working in product operating models and agile contexts, with understanding of how architecture enables rather than constrains product team autonomy and delivery velocity Background in telco operations and BSS domains with deep understanding of the technical and organizational challenges in transforming mission-critical systems that directly impact revenue Our leadership standards Looking in: Leading inclusively and Safely I inspire and build trust through self-awareness, honesty and integrity. Owning outcomes I take the right decisions that benefit the broader organisation. Looking out: Delivering for the customer I execute brilliantly on clear priorities that add value to our customers and the wider business. Commercially savvy I demonstrate strong commercial focus, bringing an external perspective to decision-making. Looking to the future: Growth mindset I experiment and identify opportunities for growth for both myself and the organisation.
