title: GS Software Engineer
jobDescription: Recruiter: Mounika Nagabhiru Hiring Manager: Chirag Kantilal Dave Career Grade: E About the role Telecom mediation and rating platforms process billions of events every single day —usage records, network events, charging inputs, partner settlements, and more. These events must be collected, confirmed, transformed, enriched, and delivered with absolute accuracy and reliability . Even a small failure can lead to revenue leakage, incorrect billing, compliance issues, customer dissatisfaction, or fraud exposure. This role ensures that every event flowing through BT’s networks is captured, processed, rated, and handed off correctly to downstream systems including Billing, Assurance, Fraud Management, and MIS platforms . The software you build and maintain directly safeguards BT’s revenue, operational integrity, and customer trust. By ensuring high throughput, fault inclusive, and secure mediation and rating processes, this role plays a pivotal part in enabling BT to bill accurately, detect anomalies quickly, make data driven decisions, and deliver seamless customer experiences across all services. In short: you keep the business running, the revenue secure, and the network intelligent. What you’ll be doing • Technical Solution Delivery Supports the implementation of technical solutions for internal and external customers across telecom mediation flows, resolving inter system issues and contributing within cross functional squads. • Architecture & Technology Choices Contributes to technical decisions, technology selection, and architecture direction for high performance mediation platforms, balancing immediate product needs with long term transformation. • Software Design & Development Supports the creation and development of software components aligned with enterprise architecture and BT’s security standards. • Continuous Learning & Technical Reviews Undertakes code and create reviews to enhance proficiency and ensure alignment with software engineering principles and industry standards. • Technical Specifications & Low Complexity Builds Helps create technical specifications and develops software solutions for smaller or less complex initiatives, ensuring high quality delivery. • Coding & Testing Writes, attempts, debugs, and reviews code under supervision, ensuring clarity and quality across engineering teams. • Systems Integration Integrates existing software products and resolves routine issues to ensure interoperability across diverse platforms and mediation layers. • Defect Management Monitors, troubleshoots, and corrects software defects to ensure platform reliability and service stability. • Tooling & Automation Supports the implementation, optimization, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines and automation tooling that improve developer efficiency and accelerate delivery. • Technical Roadmap Contribution Supports delivery of a forward-looking technical roadmap that meets needs of engineering teams, operations, and business stakeholders. • Engineering & Operational Excellence Assists in defining and implementing metrics, processes, and continuous improvement initiatives to drive engineering maturity. • Process Improvement Contributes to refining and optimizing engineering ways of working within the software engineering domain. Essential Skills / Experience • Expertise in Oracle OCOMC/ONM (v6/12/15) , including cartridge development (EEs, PO components, Chains, Pipelines), NPL scripting for transformation, enrichment and correlation, CDR parsing, normalization and aggregation, file collection and distribution, high-throughput processing of multi-network event types, along with deployment, performance tuning and troubleshooting of mediation workflows. • Strong background in Java/J2EE development , with experience in building and consuming REST APIs, multi-threaded processing and concurrency, along with proficiency in scripting (Shell/Python/Perl) for automation, tooling, and monitoring. • Strong experience with Web Logic Application Server, including deployment and tuning of Java applications, JVM performance optimization, cluster management, JDBC tuning and thread pool configuration, along with troubleshooting of memory leaks, stuck threads, and connection-related issues. • Hands-on experience with Netcracker Revenue Manager (NCRM/NC-RM) or equivalent rating ecosystems, including rating engine concepts, charge calculation flows, configuration of price plans, rating rules, usage types, event models • Proven ability in debugging rating discrepancies and missing usage events, working with product catalog, tariff models, charging rules and discounts, ensuring seamless Mediation → Rating → Billing alignment, and helping both batch and near-real-time rating workflows. • Strong understanding of telecom network feed formats helping Mediation and Rating systems, including Diameter (CCR/CCA), ASN.1-based CDRs, TAP/RAP/NRTRDE for roaming, 3GPP CDR formats (Vo LTE, 5G, GTP’, SIP, CAMEL), IPDR, and vendor-specific formats (Huawei, Ericsson, Nokia, Cisco), along with the ability to decode, interpret, map, and troubleshoot raw collaborative events. Desirable Skills / Experience • 4–7 years of hands-on software development experience with strong proficiency in Java and related technologies • Minimum 5 years of deep, practical experience in delivering OCOMC (Offline Mediation Controller) solutions, including cartridge development, NPL scripting, mediation and rating workflows, CDR processing, and production deployments. • Demonstrate experience in building, enhancing, and maintaining high volume mediation pipelines capable of processing billions of daily events with high accuracy, low latency, and strong fault tolerance. • Strong exposure to telecom network event formats such as Diameter, ASN.1, TAP/RAP/NRTRDE, IPDR, and various 3GPP CDR structures, with the ability to analyse, decode, and map raw feed data. • Hands on expertise with CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Git, Maven, Nexus, or equivalent—covering build automation, artifact management, testing, deployment workflows, and rollback strategies. • Solid experience in production system problem solving, including issue triage, deep-dive debugging, RCA creation, and working closely with operations to ensure system stability. • Experience creating and maintaining monitoring and observability scripts (Shell/Python, Dyantrace), integrating with tools like Grafana, Prometheus, ELK, OEM, or custom dashboards to track throughput, error rates, latency, and system health. • Demonstrated ability to work on complex, large-scale distributed systems, particularly those involving high-volume ETL flows into Billing, Assurance, Fraud, and MIS platforms. • Experience collaborating in cross-functional squads, working in Agile environments, and contributing to improvement initiatives related to automation, performance tuning, and resiliency. Our Package BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers. BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive. Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best. We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

title: Content Editor Professional
jobDescription: Job Req ID: Posting Date: Function: Location: Salary: About the role This role is a critical for successful rollout of our new common Delivery Framework and operating model across BT Group, providing on what good looks like, and enabling interdependent teams to speak the same language. This role primarily supports the Content Editor Specialist in producing and managing the content that forms the single source of truth playbook for colleagues involved in delivery, establishing colleague memory of good practice with inputs, outputs, critical steps, templates, and artefacts that form the Delivery standards. The Content Editor Specialist will product content, execute against the content management strategy, and conduct user research as needed, in service of ensuring accuracy and clarity of the published delivery standards and driving up usage of the Wayfinder service and understanding/adoption of the Delivery Methodology What you’ll be doing • Supports the content creation strategy and contributes to content production of high-quality and engaging content on delivery standards • Support the team’s mission through a combination of data analysis, contact analysis, end-user research, and content audits to improve user engagement and experience • Delivers standard content editing approaches, activities and deliverables covered by guidelines at both the operational and project levels • Supports delivery of digital-first experiences drive up usage, understanding and effectiveness of the published standards in order to enable improved delivery performance and outcomes across the Digital Portfolio • Scopes and runs user research and translates into action-oriented insight • Operates content management systems to maintain accuracy and relevant of Wayfinder content • Assists in the implementation of ways to improve the technical work within area of responsibility using partner feedback, user testing results, and other research to improve content • Ensures all content is aligned with the BT Group brand tone of voice, meets AA accessibility standards and is legally compliant Essential Skills / Experience • Delivery methodologies: Demonstrable understanding of different industry best practice delivery methodologies • Content management: Leverages processes and technologies to facilitate the capture, organisation, and sharing of information in multiple formats. • User research[TG1.1]: Builds understanding of user behaviours, needs, and motivations through observation techniques, task analysis, and other feedback methodologies, and translates this into insights • User-centred design: Applies an continuous design process focusing on the users and their needs in each phase of the design process. • Content management systems: Uses computer software to manage the creation and modification of digital content. • Content quality process management: Ensures that content creation processes produce quality deliverables. • Information architecture: Organises, structures, and labels content in a way that helps users find information and complete tasks. • Accessibility & inclusive design: Ensure that the design of products, processes and practices takes into account accessibility, inclusion, and diversity. • Content operations[TG2.1]: Manages processes, people, and technologies needed to ensure the proper planning, creating, managing, and analysing of all content types. Desirable Skills / Experience • Experience managing delivery in some capacity would be a significant advantage • Previous experience creating and managing content related to delivery performance. • Previous experience with website and user-centred design and programming. BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers. BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive. Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best. We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies. title: Associate Engineer MEAS
jobDescription:
The Advanced Network Technician 4 delivers hardware, configuration and fiber connectivity of interdependent scaling projects across several client locations. What you’ll be doing
1. Delivers critical customer technical support for network, hardware, and infrastructure development.
2. Executes across technical areas including systems requirements data analysis, engineering, systems design, systems development, computer programming, systems testing and deployment, quality assurance, configuration management, and systems documentation.
3. Analyses user interfaces, maintains network, hardware, and software performance tuning, analyses workload and computer usage, maintains interfaces with outside systems, and analyses proposed system modifications and upgrades.
4. Defines the problem and develops system requirements and specifications.
5. Prepares required documentation including program-level and user-level documentation; enhances existing software systems.
6. Manages work and priorities through ticketing system and workflow.
7. Collaborates with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles.
8. Troubleshoots networking, routing and interconnectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configuration and low to mid-level application interaction.
9. Participates in the migration, basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware.
10. Delivers support to include project management tasks, meeting facilitation, and ad hoc duties as needed.
11. Executes and delivers within standardised procedures in order to achieve objectives and the vision of the Network Engineering team. 8. Supports the operation and management of distributed storage architecture
9. Monitors queue and support processing to support in the identification of early warning of support issues

title: Customer Solutions Design Practitioner
jobDescription:
The Customer Solutions Design Practitioner delivers end-to-end technical designs, ensuring that business requirements are successful translated into deliverable solutions, which meet customer needs whilst considering the impact of those solutions on all technical and business areas. What you’ll be doing
1. Captures detailed customer technical requirements and translation to detailed solution design in accordance with design methodologies.
2. Executes the technical direction and delivers optimum solution design for customers.
3. Reviews and validates both new developments and in-life products and services, ensuring full integration across all aspects.
4. Contributes to the improvement of design and delivery capabilities for end-to-end technical solutions.
5. Delivers customer solution design engagement and statement of work creation, including any 3rd party deliverables.
6. Executes customer migration planning and implementation.
7. Supports on impact assessments and design documentation updates.
8. Supports all parties throughout the project lifecycle to determine the optimum solution design for customers.
9. Resolves solution and service issues, leads root cause analysis, troubleshooting and escalation.
10. Undertakes the delivery of performance and process improvements.
11. Develops and shares with team knowledge on emerging trends and changes in customer solution design.
12. Supports the implementation of ways to improve working processes within the area of customer solution design through data analysis to identify issues and areas of improvements. title: Software Engineering Specialist
jobDescription: Job Req ID: 60910 Posting Date: 14-August-2026 Function: Software Engineering Location: Bengaluru Salary: Competitive About the role • The Physical Network Inventory team are responsible for maintaining the inventory systems that are used to plan and build the Openreach network. • These systems have been fundamental in supporting the Openreach rollout of full fibre to the UK. • The role also involves futureproofing these critical systems to ensure they remain available, operational and well supported into the future. What you’ll be doing • Supports the design and development of software solutions in accordance with the wider architecture and security standards • Create & maintain the architectural designs for ESRI solutions and interface solutions. • Undertaking technical reviews to continually update knowledge and skills in software engineering principles and practices, ensuring a base level of technical specialism proficiency to enable industry and quality standards to positively impact work and customers • Supports with the designs of technical specifications and development of software solutions of smaller and /or less complex initiatives in partnership with team, contributing towards the quality of delivery • Writing, tests and reviewing code, refining and rewriting as necessary, communicating to engineering professionals and colleagues involved in the project • May support engineering and operational excellence initiatives, assisting with implementing metrics and processes for regular assessment and improvement • Supports in the implementation of ways to improve working processes within the area of software engineering responsibility • You will work alongside a team responsible for migrating Openreach’s Physical Inventory (PNI) system onto a new future proofed platform, focussing on o Integration of the new system to existing platforms. o Defining, implementing and supporting the rollout of the new PNI system • You will own development of tools and interfaces to support the migration. • You will develop and port functionality into the new inventory system. Essential Skills / Experience • Essential: • Extensive experience in Arc GIS Enterprise, Arc GIS Pro, Arc GIS Server, Portal for Arc GIS, and Utility Network Model (UNM), TDN architecture and implementation. • Programming/Scripting: Strong development skills of applications and web applications/APIs. Ability to script to support automation. • Application Development: Ability to develop new or existing applications to deliver functionality or enhance to address bugs, focussing on Java and spring boot/framework. • Software Testing: Be familiar and capable of testing software at the unit and integration test levels through automation. Be comfortable with Test Driven Development and Java unit test frameworks like Junit and Spock • Database Design & Development: Strong expertise in database design and development, including the application of best practices such as data modelling, normalization, performance tuning, and scalability considerations. Proven hands-on experience implementing and optimizing database solutions using Postgre SQL/Post GIS and Oracle, with a solid understanding of data architecture, query optimization, and enterprise data management. • IT Security: Able to understand the security risks in an application and propose/implement fixes to harden the security of applications. • Strong Solution Architecture expertise, including High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), architecture governance, and design assurance. • Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale GIS and geospatial platforms. • Strong Integration Architecture skills covering REST APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, API gateways, and enterprise integration patterns. • Hands-on development experience with Java, Spring Boot, and API development. • Experience in data migration, ETL frameworks, data reconciliation, and data quality management. • Strong understanding of Identity & Access Management (IAM), role-based access control, Row-Level Security (RLS), and security architecture. • Experience designing for performance, scalability, resilience, availability, and disaster recovery. • Hands-on experience with Dev Ops practices, CI/CD pipelines, source control, and automated testing. • Ability to lead technical design workshops, architecture reviews, and cross-functional engineering teams. • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with business, architecture, delivery, and supplier teams. • Experience working within large-scale transformation programmes and managing multiple technology suppliers. Desirable Skills / Experience • Telecom industry experience, particularly in: Physical Network Inventory, Fibre and network inventory systems, Planning and Work Management systems • Experience with ESRI Utility Network migration programmes. • Knowledge of FME, Arc Py, Python, and GIS automation frameworks. • Experience with Arc GIS SDK, Arcade, Arc GIS Python SDK, Notebooks, and Geo AI capabilities. • Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within the ESRI ecosystem. • Knowledge of observability and monitoring platforms such as Dynatrace. • Experience with data governance, master data management, and regulatory compliance. • Previous experience leading offshore, nearshore, and multi-vendor development teams. • Industry certifications such as: ESRI Technical Certification, TMF BT is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers. BT’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive. Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best. We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies. experienceProfile.rawText: Job Req ID: 60910 Posting Date: 14-August-2026 Function: Software Engineering Location: Bengaluru Salary: Competitive About the role • The Physical Network Inventory team are responsible for maintaining the inventory systems that are used to plan and build the Openreach network. • These systems have been fundamental in supporting the Openreach rollout of full fibre to the UK. • The role also involves futureproofing these critical systems to ensure they remain available, operational and well supported into the future. What you'll be doing • Supports the design and development of software solutions in accordance with the wider architecture and security standards • Create & maintain the architectural designs for ESRI solutions and interface solutions. • Undertaking technical reviews to continually update knowledge and skills in software engineering principles and practices, ensuring a base level of technical specialism proficiency to enable industry and quality standards to positively impact work and customers • Supports with the designs of technical specifications and development of software solutions of smaller and /or less complex initiatives in partnership with team, contributing towards the quality of delivery • Writing, tests and reviewing code, refining and rewriting as necessary, communicating to engineering professionals and colleagues involved in the project • May support engineering and operational excellence initiatives, assisting with implementing metrics and processes for regular assessment and improvement • Supports in the implementation of ways to improve working processes within the area of software engineering responsibility • You will work alongside a team responsible for migrating Openreach's Physical Inventory (PNI) system onto a new future proofed platform, focussing on o Integration of the new system to existing platforms. o Defining, implementing and supporting the rollout of the new PNI system • You will own development of tools and interfaces to support the migration. • You will develop and port functionality into the new inventory system. Essential Skills / Experience • Essential: • Extensive experience in Arc GIS Enterprise, Arc GIS Pro, Arc GIS Server, Portal for Arc GIS, and Utility Network Model (UNM), TDN architecture and implementation. • Programming/Scripting: Strong development skills of applications and web applications/APIs. Ability to script to support automation. • Application Development: Ability to develop new or existing applications to deliver functionality or enhance to address bugs, focussing on Java and spring boot/framework. • Software Testing: Be familiar and capable of testing software at the unit and integration test levels through automation. Be comfortable with Test Driven Development and Java unit test frameworks like Junit and Spock • Database Design & Development: Strong expertise in database design and development, including the application of best practices such as data modelling, normalization, performance tuning, and scalability considerations. Proven hands-on experience implementing and optimizing database solutions using Postgre SQL/Post GIS and Oracle, with a solid understanding of data architecture, query optimization, and enterprise data management. • IT Security: Able to understand the security risks in an application and propose/implement fixes to harden the security of applications. • Strong Solution Architecture expertise, including High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), architecture governance, and design assurance. • Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale GIS and geospatial platforms. • Strong Integration Architecture skills covering REST APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, API gateways, and enterprise integration patterns. • Hands-on development experience with Java, Spring Boot, and API development. • Experience in data migration, ETL frameworks, data reconciliation, and data quality management. • Strong understanding of Identity & Access Management (IAM), role-based access control, Row-Level Security (RLS), and security architecture. • Experience designing for performance, scalability, resilience, availability, and disaster recovery. • Hands-on experience with Dev Ops practices, CI/CD pipelines, source control, and automated testing. • Ability to lead technical design workshops, architecture reviews, and cross-functional engineering teams. • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with business, architecture, delivery, and supplier teams. • Experience working within large-scale transformation programmes and managing multiple technology suppliers. Desirable Skills / Experience • Telecom industry experience, particularly in: Physical Network Inventory, Fibre and network inventory systems, Planning and Work Management systems • Experience with ESRI Utility Network migration programmes. • Knowledge of FME, Arc Py, Python, and GIS automation frameworks. • Experience with Arc GIS SDK, Arcade, Arc GIS Python SDK, Notebooks, and Geo AI capabilities. • Exposure to Generative AI and Agentic AI capabilities within the ESRI ecosystem. • Knowledge of observability and monitoring platforms such as Dynatrace. • Experience with data governance, master data management, and regulatory compliance. • Previous experience leading offshore, nearshore, and multi-vendor development teams. • Industry certifications such as: ESRI Technical Certification, TMF BT is the UK's leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country's most recognised brands - including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers. BT's role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive. Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next - simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best. We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country's most important companies.
